pages.text: Place a writable book, Big Book, Recipe Book, or Clipboard in the desk’s center writing slot. Right-click the placed item to open its editor or reader. Sneak-right-click the same area to take it back.
Use an axe to mine the desk and recover its stored items.

pages.title: Desk Storage
pages.text: Right-click either book pile to add a book and sneak-right-click to remove the top one. Right-click the cloth area with carpet to dress the desk. A filled map in the writing slot shows terrain.

pages.title: Desk Rows
pages.text: Place multiple desks with their fronts aligned. Sneak-use either drill on one desk and then its adjacent partner to join their sections. Repeat the selection to split them.
